basics.label: Professor of Herbology, Resistance Leader & Decorated War Veteran
basics.name: NEVILLE LONGBOTTOM
basics.summary: Accomplished Herbology scholar, internationally recognised experimental botanist, and decorated veteran of the Second Wizarding War. Professor of Herbology at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, holding the position continuously since 2000. Led Dumbledore's Army resistance operations under Death Eater occupation at age seventeen, coordinated the defence of Hogwarts castle, and personally destroyed Voldemort's final Horcrux. Research focus on magically-responsive plant cultivars, medicinal herbological applications, and the conservation of endangered wizarding flora. Former Auror. Gryffindor, through and through.

projects.description: A multi-institution conservation programme aimed at cataloguing, seed-banking, and cultivating endangered magical plant species. Partners include the Royal Botanic Gardens at Kew, the Beauxbatons Botanical Institute, and two Scandinavian magical natural history museums.
highlights: Catalogued 63 species of endangered magical flora across the Hogwarts grounds and surrounding region
Established a living seed bank of over 200 species in the Hogwarts greenhouse complex
Developed propagation protocols for four species previously considered uncultivable in captivity
Trained twelve botanical researchers from partner institutions in magical plant handling and cultivation
projects.name: Hogwarts Rare Wizarding Flora Preservation Programme

projects.description: Designed, planted, and oversaw the establishment of the permanent memorial garden in Hogwarts's east grounds, commemorating those killed in the Battle of Hogwarts. Each planting was selected for symbolic resonance with the qualities of those remembered.
highlights: Designed a planting scheme representing 51 individual fallen defenders, each with a named species chosen in consultation with their families
Personally planted and maintained all specimens until full establishment
Installed enchanted permanent-bloom charms on five central specimens, designed to flower year-round in perpetuity
The Garden has since become an annual pilgrimage site on the anniversary of the Battle, maintained by Hogwarts students as a service project

publications.summary: Longitudinal study examining the spread and management of invasive magical plant species in the Hogwarts grounds and Forbidden Forest, offering a long-term dataset on inter-species dynamics in a managed magical environment.

publications.name: Mandrake Restorative Draught Potency: The Impact of Soil Composition and Maturation Rate
publications.summary: Research paper demonstrating that modifications to Mandrake cultivation soil composition and controlled maturation timing significantly improve the potency and reliability of the standard Restorative Draught formula. Adopted into revised St Mungo's treatment protocols.

publications.name: Teaching Herbology to Traumatised Learners: A Framework for Post-Conflict Magical Education
publications.summary: Practitioner-focused paper drawing on Neville's experience teaching post-war students at Hogwarts, proposing a trauma-sensitive pedagogical framework applicable across magical subjects with particular relevance to Herbology's sensory and practical elements.

references.name: Harry Potter, Head Auror — Ministry of Magic
references.reference: "Neville is one of the bravest people I've ever known — and I mean that in a specific, evidence-based way. He spent an entire year leading resistance against Death Eaters while the rest of us were on the run, took punishment that would have broken most adults, and then showed up for the Battle without hesitation. He destroyed the last Horcrux while I was supposed to be dead. That sort of person, you don't forget. As a professor he's exceptional — every student who's come through his Herbology class comes out of it actually caring about the subject."

references.name: Professor Minerva McGonagall, Headmistress — Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry
references.reference: "Professor Longbottom has exceeded every expectation I had when I appointed him, and my expectations were already high. He has built the Herbology programme into one of the finest in Britain while simultaneously serving as an exemplary Head of House. His commitment to student welfare — particularly to students who carry the weight of the war years — reflects the very best of Gryffindor values. I will not pretend he was my most promising student when in his first year. He has earned the right to find that funny."

references.name: Gran (Augusta Longbottom), Retired Healer and Family Matriarch
references.reference: "I am not surprised about any of it. I always knew he had it in him. I said so repeatedly. He also remembered to water my Mimbulus Mimbletonia when I was away for Christmas 1996, which speaks to reliable responsibility and that counts for a great deal."

highlights: Supplied specially cultivated Mandrake rootstock for 'de-Petrification' therapy protocols, improving the potency and reliability of the restorative draught used for Petrification casualties
Consulted on the treatment of Venomous Tentacula exposure in four emergency cases, providing time-sensitive identification and recommended antidote plant components
Visits the Long-Term Residential Ward quarterly — where his parents remain patients — participating in the visiting relatives support group and advocating for patient welfare funding
volunteer.organization: St Mungo's Hospital for Magical Maladies and Injuries
volunteer.summary: Provides ongoing consultancy to St Mungo's Potions-Based Treatment Division on the sourcing, cultivation, and preparation of medicinal magical plants used in long-term patient care. Donates annually from the Hogwarts greenhouse surplus to the hospital's apothecary stores.

highlights: Oversaw the design and planting of the Battle of Hogwarts Memorial Garden, a permanent installation in the castle's east grounds featuring plants selected to symbolise each fallen defender
Personally selected and planted the central memorial grove of white flowering hawthorn — sustaining three years of care until establishment
Coordinated the formal dedication ceremony attended by over two hundred families of the fallen and members of the wizarding government
volunteer.summary: Co-chaired the committee responsible for planning and erecting the Hogwarts memorial to those killed in the Battle of Hogwarts, including the design of the memorial gardens in the castle grounds.

highlights: Redesigned the First through Third Year Herbology curriculum upon appointment, incorporating updated Ministry of Magic classification standards and hands-on practical assessment replacing written-only examinations
Expanded the Hogwarts greenhouse complex from five to seven structures, adding specialist facilities for venomous, carnivorous, and magically-active plant species
Supervised 34 N.E.W.T.-level independent research projects over his tenure, with twelve students going on to careers in Herbological research or the Magical Plant protection sector
Developed a post-war trauma-sensitive teaching approach, particularly for students who experienced Hogwarts under Death Eater administration, receiving commendation from the Headmistress

Launched the Hogwarts Rare Wizarding Flora Preservation Programme, a collaboration with the Royal Botanic Gardens at Kew and three European magical institutions, cataloguing and preserving seeds and cuttings of endangered magical plant species
Led annual Forbidden Forest botanical surveys, discovering and formally documenting two previously uncatalogued magical plant species in the castle grounds
Introduced the 'Herbology in Healing' elective module for Fifth Years, linking plant-based potion ingredients to practical medical and apothecary applications
Served as Head of Gryffindor House since 2003, overseeing pastoral care, scholarship guidance, and inter-house relations
work.name: Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry
work.summary: Responsible for delivering Herbology instruction across all year groups, from First Year introduction to N.E.W.T.-level specialist coursework. Oversees the management of the Hogwarts greenhouse complex — a seven-greenhouse facility housing over 400 catalogued species. Serves on the staff curriculum committee, student welfare board, and heads the Gryffindor House pastoral team.

highlights: Participated in the capture of six Death Eaters during active field operations in 1998–1999, including two who had been wrongly cleared by the Ministry in the aftermath of the First Wizarding War
Commended by Head Auror Harry Potter for exceptional composure and tactical effectiveness during the Knockturn Alley sweep operations of late 1998
Completed the full Auror training programme in twelve months despite no formal post-Hogwarts qualification — accepted to the programme on the basis of battlefield record alone
Contributed firsthand field notes on Death Eater tactics and safe houses that informed twelve successful warrant operations
Remained on reserve call-up with the Auror Office following transition to teaching; participated in two subsequent special operations in 2002 and 2005
work.name: Ministry of Magic — Auror Office
work.summary: Served as a trained Auror in the post-war Ministry following the fall of Voldemort. Participated in the identification and apprehension of Death Eaters who evaded capture in the immediate aftermath of the Battle of Hogwarts. Left the Auror Office to take up the Hogwarts Herbology post when a vacancy arose — a role considered better suited to his long-term aspirations and expertise.

highlights: Reformed Dumbledore's Army in September 1997 after the Death Eater takeover of the Ministry and Hogwarts, despite severe personal risk — willingly accepted repeated punishments from the Carrows to shield other students

Established the Room of Requirement as a full residential refuge for students at risk of persecution by the Carrows, sustainably housing up to twenty students at a time with food, supplies, and communication infrastructure
Coordinated the use of Aberforth Dumbledore's Hogsmeade contacts to maintain supply lines into the Room of Requirement throughout the 1997–98 academic year
Personally led DA fighters to admit Harry Potter, Ron Weasley, and Hermione Granger into the castle via the Hog's Head passage, facilitating the start of the Battle of Hogwarts
Commanded a section of Hogwarts's defensive perimeter during the Battle, directing student fighters and coordinating with staff and Order members throughout the engagement
Destroyed Nagini with the Sword of Gryffindor — eliminating Voldemort's final Horcrux and enabling Harry Potter to defeat Voldemort permanently
work.name: Dumbledore's Army — Hogwarts Resistance
work.summary: Led the reformation and operational command of Dumbledore's Army during the Death Eater occupation of Hogwarts School under Headmaster Severus Snape and the Carrow siblings. Maintained active student resistance, coordinated protective actions for vulnerable students, and organised the defence of the castle during the Battle of Hogwarts.
